title: The elif Statement
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose and main behavior of the elif statement.

Identify one limitation, edge case, compatibility concern, or failure mode relevant to the topic.

content.intro: This lesson introduces the elif statement as part of python conditional statements. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: The key is to connect syntax to the value or behavior it produces. Start with a small expression, predict its result, and then verify it in the interpreter.
